sources.entry: 015 - A temporary file sharing platform. Focused on providing one-time, temporary file and text upload, processing, and sharing services. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: 015 is a self-hosted temporary file and text sharing platform built with Vue 3/Nuxt 4 and Go, focused on one-time uploads and shares.
summary.what_it_does: 015 provides a web interface for uploading files and text and generating share links for them. Large files are uploaded in chunks, and the frontend computes file hashes so duplicate uploads can be skipped (instant transfer). Uploads can be resumed from chunks the server already has. Shares support password protection, download count limits, and expiration, with short pickup codes for easier sharing. A backend queue (Redis and Asynq) with a separate Go worker handles asynchronous tasks such as image compression and format conversion. The interface offers file previews for images and videos and supports seven languages.
use_cases: share large files temporarily with someone
self-host a temporary file transfer site
share files with password and download limits
how_to_run: Download config.example.yaml and docker-compose.yml from the repository
Rename config.example.yaml to config.yaml and configure it
Visit the address shown in the README (the URL was truncated in the source)
notable: Instant transfer: detects existing uploads by file hash and size to avoid re-uploading duplicate data
Separate Go worker service processes queued tasks such as image compression
Share controls include password, download count limits, and expiration
Web Worker-based frontend hash calculation and concurrent chunked upload
caveats: Several roadmap items (image OCR, document to Markdown, text translation/summarization) are planned but not built
Storage is local file system only, per the README
Setup requires Redis and a config file; the Docker quick start README link was truncated
